facts.fact: KfW's IATI record shows a EUR 20,000,000 grant (US$21.64 million), committed in 2024 for 2024-2028 with nothing yet disbursed, that finances extension of the fibre network and the connection of public institutions, named as town halls, hospitals and schools, to it.
